title: Adaptive alert probation and prefetch span sampler
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds tenant-aware alert probationing and a sampler for prefetch/span traces to reduce noise from transient warmup effects. Includes dashboard and SLO tuning guidance.
description:
Context: We get frequent noisy alerts during predictable seasonal traffic and during prefetch/warmup waves that originate from background prefetch work. This PR introduces two coordinated mechanisms: 1) an adaptive alert probation layer that gates new alert instances per-tenant/callsite combination for a configurable probation window before firing escalations, and 2) a lightweight 'prefetch span sampler' that marks and preferentially samples spans originating from background prefetch pipelines so their signal can be counted without overwhelming alerts. Motivation: reduce alert fatigue and false positive escalation during warmup and short-lived bursts without losing signal for persistent regressions. What this PR does (high level): - Implements alert probation rules in the alerting pipeline with per-tenant, per-callsite counters and decay windows. Probation behavior is configurable via console feature flag and defaults to a 30m probation window for new alert groups. - Adds a prefetch_span flag to spans emitted by the prefetch subsystem and a sampler that upweights prefetch spans for storage/observability but suppresses immediate alert escalation where appropriate. - Introduces new metrics: observability.alerts.probation.count, observability.alerts.probation.active_tenants, observability.prefetch.span_sampled, and observability.prefetch.sample_rate_by_workload. - Adds a dashboard (Observability > Alert Probation) that visualizes probation queue, top callsites in probation, and prefetch sampling rates, plus an ops runbook section. - Includes unit and integration tests for probation eviction, persistence (short-lived memstore with opt-in Redis backing), and sampler fairness. - Adds migration script to backfill probation metadata for unacknowledged, recently-fired alerts (best-effort). Backwards compatibility and rollout: probation is off-by-default. The console exposes a gradual ramp (off -> sampling mode -> enforced probation) and a tenant whitelist to enable probation for pilot customers. Prefetch sampling is enabled for internal prefetch pipelines only by default. Checklist: - [x] Core probation engine implementation - [x] Prefetch span flagging and sampler - [x] Metrics + dashboard panel definitions - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Migration/backfill script - [x] Docs: runbook + console toggle entries

Commits summary: - a1d9f2c add probation store and eviction policy - b3f90e7 wire probation into alert evaluator and add metrics - c17b4f1 prefetch span tagging & sampler implementation - d4e3b01 dashboard panels + runbook content - e2a7c5b tests + migration script - f9b2d44 docs & console feature flag

Changed areas (high level): - observability/alerting/probation_engine.py - observability/alerting/evaluator.py - tracing/prefetch/sampler.py - metrics/definitions.yaml - dashboards/alert_probation.json - migrations/20241105_backfill_probation.py - tests/test_probation.py - docs/observability/alert_probation.md

CI and validation: Initial CI run failed due to a linter error (flake8: unused-import) and one flaky integration test (test_probation_eviction race on CI). Author fixed lint and added a stabilization retry to the integration harness; subsequent CI passed all checks (unit, integration, lint, e2e with mocked spans). Load testing: small perf bench shows <2% p99 alert evaluation latency overhead at 1000rps with probation store in-memory; Redis-backed mode adds 6-10ms median latency under contention but stays within SLO for Dedicated tier.

Migration notes: the backfill script is best-effort and idempotent; it marks recent alerts (last 1h) as already-seen so they do not immediately enter probation when the feature is enabled. Ops should run the backfill in a maintenance window for large tenants.

Rollout plan: 1) Merge behind console feature flag; 2) Enable sampling mode for select pilot tenants; 3) Monitor probation metrics for noise reduction and any missed regressions for 72 hours; 4) Flip to enforced probation in waves; 5) Optionally enable Redis backing for probation store for tenants with large callsite cardinality.

Merge outcome: squashed and merged after approvals and green CI.
